rules.when: a worker runs on this runtime
rules.why: omp renders a trust dialog before any composer; no key may answer it, so a card is raised and the endpoint is closed instead. A plain Enter submits. Its status row below the composer is furniture, never absorbed as wrapped input. One Escape cancels the turn and leaves the composer empty, so no clear key and no arm signal are needed. A relaunch cannot resume an exact session, so it starts fresh. While a turn runs the pane carries a `Working…` line with a horizontal ellipsis, or a braille spinner frame with an elapsed cell; idle it carries a static identity glyph and no elapsed time. Busy is read from its extension, never from those rows.
